title: Kokoro-82M TTS via sherpa-onnx (int8 asset, lexicon frontend)
notes: Verified live 2026-11-09 (k2-fsa TTS docs + release assets + PR #4055 + issue #4139). Weights Apache-2.0. Relevance: Jerry SPEC-VOICE TTS pick (sentence-chunked, CPU, int8).

sections.heading: Verified facts
sections.body: Apache-2.0 weights; 54 voices; UTMOS ~4.44; 24kHz output; sherpa int8 asset kokoro-int8-multi-lang-v1_1 + voices.bin 26MB; whole-utterance 9.6s TTFA per 17s text -> chunking mandatory; fp32 RSS ~1.2GB.

sections.heading: v2.x lexicon frontend regression
sections.body: PR #4055 removed espeak (GPL-free, data_dir ignored). Issue #4139: numbers and OOV words dropped by lexicon frontend. Mitigations: spelled-out-numbers system prompt; P1 lexicon listening test; fallback Pocket TTS fp32 (int8 disqualified by #3172).
